name: CustomXMLSchemaCollection
description: Represents a collection of CustomXMLSchema objects attached to a data stream.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the CustomXMLSchemaCollection object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the CustomXMLSchemaCollection object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the CustomXMLSchemaCollection object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the CustomXMLSchemaCollection collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a CustomXMLSchema object from the CustomXMLSchemaCollection collection. Read-only.

properties.name: NamespaceURI
properties.description: Gets the unique address identifier for the namespace of the CustomXMLSchemaCollection object. Read-only.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add([NamespaceURI As String], [Alias As String], [FileName As String], [InstallForAllUsers As Boolean]) As CustomXMLSchema
methods.description: Allows you to add one or more schemas to a schema collection that can then be added to a stream in the data store and to the Schema Library.

parameters.name: NamespaceURI
parameters.description: Contains the namespace of the schema to be added to the collection. If the schema already exists in the Schema Library, the method will retrieve it from there.

parameters.name: Alias
parameters.description: Contains the alias of the schema to be added to the collection. If the alias already exists in the Schema Library, the method can find it using this argument.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: Contains the location of the schema on a disk. If this parameter is specified, the schema is added to the collection and to the Schema Library.

parameters.name: InstallForAllUsers
parameters.description: Specifies whether, in the case where the method is adding the schema to the Schema Library, the Schema Library keys should be written to the registry (HKey_Local_Machine for all users or HKey_Current_User for just the current user). The parameter defaults to False and writes to HKey_Current_User.

methods.name: AddCollection
methods.description: Adds an existing schema collection to the current schema collection.

parameters.name: SchemaCollection
parameters.description: Represents a collection of schemas to be imported into the current schema collection.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Specifies whether the schemas in a schema collection are valid (conforms to the syntactic rules of XML and the rules for a specified vocabulary; a standard for structuring XML).
